name: Clicking a Quarterfinal cell reaches a match page labeled Quarterfinal
description: When a visitor clicks a Quarterfinal cell in the bracket, the destination match page surfaces a Quarterfinal stage label — proving stage context follows the navigation, not just the homepage chrome.

planSteps.description: Scroll down to the knockout bracket section
Click a cell in the Quarterfinal area of the bracket
Verify the destination URL differs from the homepage URL

Verify the destination page surfaces a Quarterfinal stage indicator — accepting any of QF, Quarterfinal, Quarter-final, Quarter Final, Quarter Finals, or a heading/breadcrumb whose first word starts with Q
